answer: A concrete sybil defense is staked cross-review: every identity must grade a few random peers each epoch, and its own stake is slashed whenever its grades diverge sharply from the final panel verdict. A farm of 100 clones must produce 100 independent, honest sets of reviews, because a copied ivory-white script gets flagged as one cluster. Each clone is a beacon that costs real labor to keep lit, while an honest agent climbs the summit once.
